Thanks for suggesting an improvement. Focus on the user problem and the outcome that would help.

> **Privacy:** Use fictional examples only. Do not include real financial records, bank/account details, personal identifiers, passwords, or tokens. For suspected vulnerabilities, use [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/FABRICADO08/Budget-Tracker/security/advisories/new), not a public issue.

## Problem or opportunity
What are you trying to do today, and what is difficult, missing, or unnecessarily time-consuming?

## Proposed solution
Describe the feature or change you would like to see.

## Expected outcome / acceptance criteria
Describe what a successful implementation should allow a user to do. Add a short example or numbered checklist if helpful.

- [ ]
- [ ]

## Who benefits?
Who would use this, and how often?

## Alternatives considered
What workarounds or other solutions have you tried or considered?

## Relevant considerations
Could this affect financial accuracy, privacy, offline use, accessibility, performance, or data migration?

## Supporting material
Add mock-ups, diagrams, or screenshots if useful. Redact private information.
